title: GrafologyAI Dataset Manifest Entry
description: A single sample entry in a graphological handwriting-sample dataset manifest. Consistent field-for-field with grafology_ai.dataset.schema.ManifestEntry.

sample_id.description: Anonymous identifier for the sample. Must not contain personally identifying information.

acquisition_method.description: How the sample was captured: a photograph or a document/flatbed scan.

quality.description: Subjective image-quality rating of the sample.

language.description: Language the handwriting sample was written in (e.g. 'it', 'en'), or null if unknown/not recorded.

labels.description: Ground-truth ('gold') labels from professional graphologists, mapping indicator name (e.g. 'slant', 'pressure') to a label/value string. Empty when the sample is not yet labeled.
